metaDescription: Professional Land Rover engine inspection and assessment at our Essex workshop. Diagnostic scan, compression tests, borescope inspection and detailed reporting.

sections.heading: What a Land Rover Engine Inspection Involves

blocks.html: Our engine inspection and assessment process is a structured, multi-stage diagnostic procedure. We don't guess — we systematically work through from consultation and visual inspection through to mechanical tests, borescope inspection, and, where required, a full strip-down. The result is a clear, detailed inspection report with photographs of any damaged or worn components, and a quotation based on the actual scope of work identified.

We use JLR SDD/Pathfinder/TOPix diagnostic equipment and precision measuring instruments. Every inspection is carried out in our Essex workshop using the same tools and methods that inform every rebuild and replacement we undertake.

blocks.heading: Inspection & Assessment From £120
paras: Initial diagnostic inspection including visual check, diagnostic scan and basic mechanical tests. Additional specialist tests quoted separately.

blocks.html: We inspect and assess engines across the full Land Rover range. Listed below are the models and engine families we work on most frequently.

steps.title: Consultation & Reception
steps.body: We record vehicle details and your description of the issue — what happened, when, any warning signs and service history.

steps.title: Visual & Underside Inspection
steps.body: Engine bay and underside checked for fluid leaks, damage, belt condition, and external component condition.

steps.title: Diagnostic Scan
steps.body: JLR SDD/Pathfinder/TOPix connected. Fault codes, live data and freeze-frame data recorded and analysed.

steps.title: Mechanical & Borescope Tests
steps.body: Compression, leak-down, oil pressure and cooling system tests. Borescope inspection of cylinder walls and pistons.

steps.title: Oil Sample & Strip-Down
steps.body: Oil sampled for analysis. If internal damage is indicated, full strip-down is authorised and components inspected.

steps.title: Reporting & Quotation
steps.body: Detailed report with photos of damaged components. Repair options presented and quotation prepared for your authorisation.

sections.heading: How Land Rover Engine Inspection Works

steps.title: Initial Consultation
steps.body: Contact us by phone, WhatsApp, or via the website. We'll take your vehicle details and arrange a time to bring your Land Rover into our workshop.

steps.title: Inspection & Diagnostics
steps.body: Our technicians perform the structured inspection: visual, diagnostic scan, mechanical tests and, if needed, borescope inspection. Strip-down is only carried out with your authorisation.

steps.title: Report & Quotation
steps.body: We provide a detailed inspection report with photographs, outline the repair options, and supply a fixed-price quotation for the recommended work.

items.q: How long does a Land Rover engine inspection take?
items.a: A standard initial inspection including visual check and diagnostic scan takes 1–2 hours. Compression and leak-down tests add additional time. If a strip-down inspection is required, this typically takes 4–8 hours depending on engine complexity and access. We'll always give you a clear timeframe before any work begins.

items.q: Do you use official Land Rover diagnostic equipment?
items.a: Yes. We use JLR SDD/Pathfinder/TOPix diagnostic systems, which are the same systems used by official Land Rover dealers. This allows us to read and interpret fault codes and live data accurately for all Land Rover models.

items.q: What happens if I authorise a strip-down inspection?
items.a: We remove the engine from the vehicle and mount it on a stand. Components are systematically removed — ancillaries, timing cover, cylinder head(s), and sump. We inspect pistons, connecting rods, crankshaft, bearings, and cylinder bores. Any damaged parts are documented with photographs and included in your inspection report.
